description: Create an Orderly API key for the wallet, store it in the OS keychain and return the public key plus the accountId used by every other tool. Only read and trading scope can be granted through the MCP; asset (withdrawal) scope must be added with the CLI directly. Requires the wallet address and, for a new account, the broker ID.

address.description: Wallet address (required for AI/scripts, prompts if omitted)

broker_id.description: Broker ID (required when no API key stored for wallet)

network.description: Network override for this call. Defaults to ORDERLY_MCP_NETWORK, then the CLI config.

scope.description: Key scopes: read,trading,asset (default: read,trading) One of: read, trading.

name: wallet_add_key
title: Issue an API key (onboarding step 3)
